field.label: Action
field.help: Block drops traffic to/from the selected countries. Allow only drops everything except the selected countries (private networks and the exceptions always stay reachable). Allow only does nothing until the country database is loaded.

field.label: Direction
field.help: Inbound: packets arriving from the country (use the WAN interface). Outbound: packets from your clients to the country (use the LAN/VLAN interfaces).

field.label: Interfaces
field.help: Interfaces the rule applies to. Empty applies it everywhere.

field.label: Exceptions
field.help: Addresses or networks that are never affected by this policy.

field.label: Log
field.help: Write dropped packets to the firewall log.
